query: Hi there, I just picked up that new limited-edition phone pop socket with the constellation print the other day, but right now my phone won’t load any websites or apps when I’m not on Wi-Fi— I’m traveling abroad right now, roaming is turned off, I already used up all my monthly data, mobile data mode is toggled off, and even when I try using the VPN I have installed it still won’t connect at all.
